newsitem.title: USA: IPC Info sees FY 1996 EPS exceeding $1.37.
newsitem.headline: IPC Info sees FY 1996 EPS exceeding $1.37.

text.p: IPC Information Systems Inc said Friday it expects to report record annual revenues of about $249 million for its fiscal year ended Sept. 30, an increase of about 21% over revenues of $206 million for fiscal 1995.

Excluding the impact of start-up costs and network deployment expenses related to IPC's subsidiary, IXNET, of approximately $0.24 per share, IPC expects earnings per share for fiscal 1996 to exceed $1.37, up from $1.26 per share for fiscal 1995.

In addition to the earnings dilution relating directly to IXNET, total selling, general and administrative expenses increased in fiscal 1996, in part due to investments required to support IPC's growth initiatives in network services.
The company said it will report its fourth quarter and fiscal year results on Dec. 12.

Terry Clontz, president and chief executive officer, said, "We finished 1996 with steady year-over-year revenue growth in all three lines of business while establishing the momentum which has taken IXNET beyond its start-up phase."
